title: Shrimp and Portuguese Pasta Bake
description: A creamy pasta bake with shrimp and portuguese flavors, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the sausage over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the garlic and onion to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook until pink and just cooked through.
Stir in the oceanic seasoning blend and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, shrimp mixture, and heavy cream. Stir until well combined.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
